therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA crosslinking and thymidylate synthase inhibition via hepatic arterial infusion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell death through DNA damage and impaired DNA synthesis
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with metastatic colorectal cancer with liver metastasis

results.dose_information: Oxaliplatin infusion over 12 hours via HAI; Folinic Acid as 2-hour infusion via HAI on day 2; 5-Fluorouracil as continuous infusion over 48 hours on days 2, 3
